claims.claim: On October 26, 2026, the NBA signed a memorandum of understanding with the CFTC and named Kalshi and Polymarket its preferred prediction-market exchanges.
claims.episode_span: the National Basketball Association signed a memorandum of understanding with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and named Kalshi and Polymarket its preferred prediction-market exchanges
claims.source_title: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball
claims.supporting_quote: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the National Basketball Association today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to protect the integrity of professional basketball in prediction markets.

claims.claim: Kalshi and Polymarket receive NBA intellectual property, U.S. marketing rights, and Sportradar official data, with limits on markets, a personnel trading ban, and information-sharing duties.
claims.episode_span: give those two exchanges NBA intellectual property, United States marketing rights, and official data from Sportradar
claims.source_title: NBA Names Kalshi and Polymarket Preferred Exchanges
claims.supporting_quote: Both exchanges will receive NBA intellectual property rights and marketing opportunities across U.S. media channels. They will also obtain official league data from Sportradar , the NBA’s official data distribution partner, to operate and settle authorized markets.

claims.claim: Partner restrictions align with NBA sportsbook limits that include bans on first-basket player props and certain unders parlays for players expected to play limited minutes.
claims.episode_span: limiting permissible markets in line with the league’s sportsbook restrictions on first-basket player props and parlays built around statistical unders
claims.source_title: NBA Names Kalshi and Polymarket Preferred Exchanges
claims.supporting_quote: Those include prohibitions on first-basket player props and parlays built around statistical unders for players expected to receive limited playing time, according to Front Office Sports .

claims.claim: The NBA expanded its DraftKings relationship to include prediction markets and nationwide promotion, and DraftKings did not receive the preferred-exchange designation.
claims.episode_span: DraftKings’ existing relationship was expanded to include prediction markets and nationwide promotion, without that preferred-exchange label
claims.source_title: NBA Names Kalshi and Polymarket Preferred Exchanges
claims.supporting_quote: The NBA also signed an information-sharing agreement with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and expanded its existing DraftKings relationship to include prediction markets and nationwide promotion.

claims.claim: The WNBA is not automatically included in the NBA prediction-market agreements.
claims.episode_span: the WNBA is not covered unless a company signs a separate deal for its rights
claims.source_title: NBA Names Kalshi and Polymarket Preferred Exchanges
claims.supporting_quote: The WNBA is not automatically included. Prediction market companies would need separate agreements for its rights and intellectual property, according to Front Office Sports .

claims.claim: The NBA-CFTC memorandum is five pages, is not legally binding, and leaves information sharing to each party’s sole discretion.
claims.episode_span: The five-page memorandum is not legally binding: neither side must create or share information, and any sharing is at each party’s sole discretion.
claims.source_title: NBA signs MOU with CFTC and partners with prediction markets
claims.supporting_quote: The five-page MOU between the NBA and CFTC outlines a working relationship between the two parties and is concerned mainly with information sharing.

claims.claim: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig said the NBA joins MLB and the NHL in a step to protect against insider trading and fraud in prediction markets.
claims.episode_span: Chairman Michael Selig said the NBA joins Major League Baseball and the National Hockey League in a step aimed at insider trading and fraud
claims.source_title: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball
claims.supporting_quote: The NBA joins the MLB and NHL in taking a responsible step toward protecting sports integrity and market participants from abuses in prediction markets like insider trading and fraud.

claims.claim: On October 8 the NFL backed New Jersey’s request for Supreme Court review of a Kalshi dispute, arguing game-outcome contracts are gambling rather than swaps, and the Court has not agreed to hear the case.
claims.episode_span: on October 8 it backed New Jersey’s request that the U.S. Supreme Court review a Kalshi dispute
claims.source_title: NBA Inks CFTC Insider-Trading Pact, Backs Kalshi, Polymarket
claims.supporting_quote: On October 8, the NFL backed New Jersey in its request for the U.S. Supreme Court to review a dispute involving Kalshi.

claims.claim: S&P Dow Jones Indices and Kalshi announced a preferred-provider collaboration for index-linked event contracts and indices built from Kalshi data.
claims.episode_span: Kalshi is licensed as a preferred platform for event contracts tied to S&P DJI indices, and S&P DJI is a preferred provider for building indices from Kalshi event-contract data
claims.source_title: S&P Dow Jones Indices Collaborates with Kalshi
claims.supporting_quote: Under the agreement, Kalshi becomes a preferred prediction market platform licensed for event contracts tied to S&P DJI indices. In addition, S&P DJI becomes a preferred provider for constructing indices from Kalshi event contract data.

claims.claim: Kalshi’s contracts based on the S&P 500 and other S&P indices are not sponsored, sold, or endorsed by S&P DJI.

claims.claim: Salient public signals are incorporated relatively quickly in liquid markets and generate substantially greater underreaction when liquidity is low.
